result.title: Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks
result.summary: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. We introduce two coordinated improvements: a decoupled position--velocity normalization scheme that independently rescales each coordinate and its time derivatives, reweighting acceleration targets to balance contributions across all channels; and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy informed by the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) structure. With these improvements, our model accurately reproduces perihelion precession and relativistic time dilation, conserves energy and angular momentum to within a few percent even after completing multiple orbits around the central mass and predicts orbital trajectories across eight orbital scenarios in close, medium, and far-field regimes. These results establish that LNNs, augmented with physically motivated normalization and sampling, can reliably learn geodesic dynamics in curved spacetime. Our work also represents the first successful training of LNNs on Schwarzschild geodesics and offers a promising direction for data-driven modeling of complex relativistic systems.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文将拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）扩展到广义相对论场景，通过学习标量拉格朗日量并借 Euler–Lagrange 方程导出加速度，配合解耦的位置—速度归一化和基于 ISCO 结构的能量约束对数均匀采样，从轨迹数据中学习 Schwarzschild 测地线运动，复现近日点进动与时间膨胀，并在多轨道、多尺度场景下保持能量与角动量近似守恒。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用变分式与守恒量作为归纳偏置来抑制长时程动力学漂移的思路，可能与 LVR 关注的 latent 状态在长推理链上的稳定性、以及训练期守恒/一致性约束是否可迁移相核查，但与视觉多模态推理主线距离较远，借鉴性需较多核实。
